title: Don't do it.
text:
Poor over-priced merchandise. The one box I just got cost me $106 total with shipping. The merchandise was worth $43 and free shipping. They claim to have ex-military as testers and advisors. As a Marine combat vet, I dispute that. Unless they are a bunch of REMF's. That would explain the crappy quality.
Anybody that thinks this is good quality really has no idea of what's going on in the world.
Do NOT get involved with these people.
And they have NO customer Service.
label: negative
